pick.headline: UN Resolution 665 authorizes enforcing the Iraq embargo at sea
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of August 27, 1990, carried Egyptian Foreign Minister Abd-al-Majid reviewing the Gulf crisis, citing the Security Council's resolutions "from Resolution 660 all the way to Resolution 665" and Egypt's commitment to Kuwait's liberation.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 166, 27 August 1990
evidence.snippet: …-al-Majid referred to the resolutions issued by the UN Security Council since the Iraqi invasion of Kuwait, noting that it issued several resolutions on the crisis beginning with Resolution 660 all the way to Resolution 665. The deputy prime minister and foreign minister asserted that Egypt is following up these developments and hopes that a peaceful solution to the crisis will be found. alternates.headline: Belorussia declares independence
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of August 26, 1991, carried Radio Mayak and INTERFAX on the Belorussian Supreme Soviet's extraordinary session and a 50,000-strong Minsk rally, then a Vremya report that the parliament had suspended the republic's Communist Party and adopted a decision on independence.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 165, 26 August 1991
